method: Both existing PNGs opened through view_image and their returned pixels inspected; no figure regeneration or image editing.

images.findings: Two original loading identities are visible. Full actual lower-half mechanism boundaries and fixed-body details are shown with x/y in mm, a common signed material compression colorbar in MPa and an excluded symmetry cut. Compression coloration concentrates at the bottom-right at1.2mm. Titles, colorbar, external legend and endpoint caveat are readable. Body reference/current locations coincide because the body is fixed.

Bottom/left/right columns and signed compression/shear rows are legible. Blue/orange saved states share each row's y scale. The bottom-right compression rise and tiny signed shear profiles are visible; zero baselines, phase marker legend and specified sampling tangent caveat are present. No cross-owner endpoint averaging or smoothing was introduced.

limits: Coincident owner-specific endpoint markers can overlap; CSVs preserve all samples separately.
The common compression scale makes the much smaller signed side-face values look close to zero; their actual values and signs must be read from tables.
Only two saved states and material nominal traction are shown. These images do not qualify total Hu pressure, stable/effective grip, all-state stress analysis or mesh convergence.
Displayed coordinates are the original rounded left-associated X+lift+fluct expression, not a new equilibrium solve or a force-kernel state reconstruction.
